package sample

import (
	"github.com/weiloon1234/Foundry-Go/auth/password"
	"github.com/weiloon1234/Foundry-Go/database/codec"
	"github.com/weiloon1234/Foundry-Go/database/encrypted"
	"github.com/weiloon1234/Foundry-Go/model"
 "github.com/weiloon1234/Foundry-Go/jobs"
 "github.com/weiloon1234/Foundry-Go/decimal"
 "time"
	"github.com/weiloon1234/Foundry-Go/temporal"
	"github.com/weiloon1234/Foundry-Go/value"
)

//foundry:enum
type State string

const Enabled State = "enabled"

//foundry:model table=constructors var=Constructors key=ID
type Constructor struct {
	ID                    model.ID[Constructor]
	Bool                  bool
	MaybeBool             value.Nullable[bool]
	Number                int
	MaybeNumber           value.Nullable[int]
	Text                  string
	MaybeText             value.Nullable[string]
	PlainText             string `foundry:"role=column"`
	Bytes                 []byte
	MaybeBytes            value.Nullable[[]byte]
	Hash                  password.Hash
	MaybeHash             value.Nullable[password.Hash]
	Secret                encrypted.Text
	MaybeSecret           value.Nullable[encrypted.JSON[string]]
	State                 State
	MaybeState            value.Nullable[State]
	At                    temporal.DateTime
	MaybeAt               value.Nullable[temporal.DateTime]
	Duration              temporal.Interval
	MaybeDuration         value.Nullable[temporal.Interval]
	PlainDuration         temporal.Interval                 `foundry:"role=column"`
	PlainMaybeDuration    value.Nullable[temporal.Interval] `foundry:"role=column"`
	JSON                  value.JSON[string]
	MaybeJSON             value.Nullable[value.JSON[string]]
	ForeignID             model.ID[Other]
	MaybeForeignID        value.Nullable[model.ID[Other]]
	CustomBytes           []byte                          `foundry:"codec=bytesCodec"`
	CustomMaybeBytes      value.Nullable[[]byte]          `foundry:"codec=bytesCodec"`
	CustomInputBytes      []byte                          `foundry:"input=string,mutate=asBytes,codec=bytesCodec"`
	CustomMaybeInputBytes value.Nullable[[]byte]          `foundry:"input=string,mutate=asBytes,codec=bytesCodec"`
	CustomID              model.ID[Other]                 `foundry:"codec=idCodec"`
	CustomMaybeID         value.Nullable[model.ID[Other]] `foundry:"codec=idCodec"`
	CustomJSON            value.JSON[string]              `foundry:"codec=jsonCodec"`
	CustomHash            password.Hash                   `foundry:"codec=hashCodec"`
}
type Other struct{}

func bytesCodec() codec.Codec[[]byte]            { return codec.Bytes[[]byte]() }
func idCodec() codec.Codec[model.ID[Other]]      { return codec.ID[Other]() }
func jsonCodec() codec.Codec[value.JSON[string]] { return codec.JSON[string]() }
func hashCodec() codec.Codec[password.Hash]      { return password.Codec() }
func asBytes(v string) ([]byte, error)           { return []byte(v), nil }

//foundry:model table=plain_times var=PlainTimes key=ID
type PlainTimesRecord struct {
	ID        int
	CreatedAt temporal.DateTime                 `foundry:"role=column"`
	UpdatedAt temporal.DateTime                 `foundry:"role=column"`
	DeletedAt value.Nullable[temporal.DateTime] `foundry:"role=column"`
}

//foundry:model table=plain_families var=PlainFamilies key=ID
type PlainFamily struct {
 ID int
 Single bool `foundry:"role=column"`
 WriterID model.ID[Other] `foundry:"role=column"`
 IsPublic bool `foundry:"role=column"`
 PresentationDeclared bool `foundry:"role=column"`
 Execution jobs.ExecutionID `foundry:"role=column"`
 Bytes []byte `foundry:"codec=bytesCodec"`
 Hash password.Hash `foundry:"codec=hashCodec"`
 Number int `foundry:"role=column"`
 Amount decimal.Decimal `foundry:"role=column"`
 State State `foundry:"role=column"`
 Instant time.Time `foundry:"role=column"`
 DateTime temporal.DateTime `foundry:"role=column"`
 Date temporal.Date `foundry:"role=column"`
 Time temporal.Time `foundry:"role=column"`
 Local temporal.LocalDateTime `foundry:"role=column"`
 Duration temporal.Interval `foundry:"role=column"`
 Document value.JSON[string] `foundry:"codec=jsonCodec"`
}
//foundry:model table=entries var=Entries key=ID identity=false
type Entry struct {
 ID int
 CreatedAt temporal.DateTime `foundry:"role=time,default=database"`
}
